query: What review signals predict negative IMDb audience satisfaction?

per_column.name: script_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Reviewer's assessment of the script (poor/good/mixed) is a distinct content dimension that plausibly correlates with overall satisfaction without deterministically restating the binary label.

per_column.name: acting_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Judgment about acting is a separable quality facet that carries predictive signal about positive/negative sentiment while remaining outside the focus variable.

per_column.name: production_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Production/technical quality is another independent aspect of the review that can inform, but does not define, overall label.

per_column.name: plot_coherence
per_column.rationale: Coherence of the plot is a specific content attribute plausibly linked to satisfaction and not a mechanical restatement of the label.

per_column.name: reviewer_emotional_tone
per_column.rationale: Sentiment polarity (strongly_negative ... strongly_positive) is essentially a near-restatement of label_pos; the positive/negative label is largely a deterministic read-off of the reviewer's overall tone, so it leaks the outcome rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: comparative_benchmark
per_column.rationale: Whether the review compares the film favorably/unfavorably to others is a distinct rhetorical signal that carries predictive information without fully determining the label.

per_column.name: rec_signal
per_column.rationale: Explicit recommend/avoid is functionally equivalent to the satisfaction verdict itself; recommending vs. telling readers to avoid maps almost one-to-one onto positive/negative label, so it restates/leaks the focus.

judge.rationale: The aspect-level verdicts (script, acting, production, plot coherence) and the comparative benchmark are legitimate, non-trivial predictors that decompose the review into distinct quality dimensions each carrying genuine signal beyond raw text. However, reviewer_emotional_tone and rec_signal are near-restatements/leakage of the binary satisfaction label, since polarity and explicit recommend/avoid are essentially the outcome itself. As a set there is real predictive leverage from the aspect features, but the presence of two leaking columns lowers the clean predictive utility.
